about: The introitus of the formulary “Saint Lawrence, Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Praise and beauty are in His presence; holiness and magnificence in His sanctuary. Sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord, all the earth. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Praise and beauty are in His presence; holiness and magnificence in His sanctuary.
